parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: This is the offset of the list, it is useful for pagination. If you want to use sort mechanism, we recommend using Mongo DB.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of items that will be fetched. If there is not enough item in the datastore, returned list size may less then this value

parameters.name: type_by
parameters.description: Type of the stream. Possible values are "liveStream", "ipCamera", "streamSource", "VoD"

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Field to sort. Possible values are "name", "date", "status"

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search parameter, returns specific items that contains search string
